chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Gray hair is light, so do not pluck it."

key_terms.اَلشَّيْبُ: gray hair or whiteness of hair due to age
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نُورٌ: light; here indicating honor or a praiseworthy quality

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about plucking gray hair?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله teaches that gray hair carries a quality of light and dignity. The hadith discourages removing it by plucking, indicating an etiquette related to natural signs of age and appearance.
